name: Self-order category tabs
describe: Sticky horizontal category chip row (nav, bg-background/95, px-6 py-3, backdrop blur) with a leading "All" chip; rounded-full chips px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium, active bg-primary, inactive border bg-background.

Use at the top of every self-order menu (tablet, kiosks, mobile). Rendered at 390 wide; it scrolls horizontally in the app so the last chips are clipped. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
